name: Deep Wilderness
accessNote: Moss giants spawn in the deep Wilderness (about 6 free-to-play spawns); only Wilderness kills count towards a Krystilia assignment. This is a PvP area, so bring only expendable gear. The Slayer task/Moss giants table (pageid 298114) lists the Wilderness canoe pond spot as cannonable and safespottable (single-combat, 6 spawns).
